name: Mini-supercell (cold-core)
description: Shallow, low-CAPE supercells in the cold sector east/northeast of a cold-core 500 mb low. WFO Louisville tip sheet (Mini-Supercells): total CAPE ≤ 1000 J/kg, EL below 300 mb (~9 km), surface dewpoints ≥ mid-50s, 0-3 km CAPE concentrated near surface so even modest helicity can spin up updrafts. EL height is used here as a proxy for the EL pressure criterion. Starting point — tune across cycles.
